Our Direction

Mission and Vision

Mission

ISUFST is committed to the continuous development of an academic institution that advances knowledge, skills, and values, promoting a culture of excellence in teaching, training, research, community service, and consultancy toward lifelong learning, to teach the minds, touch the hearts, and transform the lives of graduates for nation-building.

Vision

ISUFST as the lead academic institution for sustainable science, fisheries, agricultural, industrial, technopreneurship, and technological education in the emerging global knowledge-based society in the region.

About

About the College of Informatics and Computing Innovation

The College of Informatics and Computing Innovation (CICI) at ISUFST San Enrique Campus offers programs designed to develop students' knowledge and skills in information technology and computing.

The programs prepare students with knowledge and skills in information technology, software development, web development, and mobile applications.

Information TechnologyCore computing knowledge and practice
Software DevelopmentBuilding applications and systems
Web DevelopmentDesigning and building for the web
Mobile ApplicationsDeveloping apps for mobile devices
